text.label: Text
text.info: Ink. Body copy, headings, and primary buttons.

accent.label: Accent
accent.info: Link hover, progress bars, and the focus ring. Must stay readable on the page background.

signal.label: Sale
signal.info: Used only for sale prices and the sale badge. Keeping it rare is what makes it read as a signal.

heading_scale.label: Heading size
heading_scale.info: Scales every heading level at once. Sizes stay fluid between mobile and desktop.

caption_letter_spacing.label: Caption letter spacing
caption_letter_spacing.info: Applies to small uppercase labels, including the material tag.

page_gutter.label: Page margin
page_gutter.info: Horizontal space between page content and the edge of the screen.

corner_radius.label: Corner radius
corner_radius.info: Applies to buttons, inputs, cards, and media.

show_seam_dividers.label: Show seam dividers
show_seam_dividers.info: A dashed hairline between sections instead of a solid rule.

enable_reveal.label: Reveal sections on scroll
enable_reveal.info: Always disabled for visitors who have reduced motion turned on.

card_hover_image.label: Show second image on hover
card_hover_image.info: Uses the second image on the product. Products with one image are unaffected.

card_show_material.label: Show material tag
card_show_material.info: Reads the product metafield custom.material. Hidden when the metafield is empty.

cart_free_shipping_threshold.label: Free shipping threshold
cart_free_shipping_threshold.info: In your store currency, without a currency symbol. Set to 0 to hide the progress bar.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.info: Will be scaled down to 32 x 32px.

share_image.label: Social sharing image
share_image.info: Used when a page without its own image is shared. 1200 x 630px works best.

brand_description.label: Brand description
brand_description.info: Used as the fallback meta description and in the Organization structured data.

social.name: Social media
social.info: Links appear in the footer and in structured data. Leave a field empty to hide it.

demo.name: Demo content
demo.paragraph: The theme ships with demo photography so a new store looks finished before you upload anything. Turn this off once you have added your own images.

demo_images.label: Use demo images as placeholders
demo_images.info: Only applies where you have not set an image yourself.

menu.info: For the mega menu to fill four columns, the menu needs three levels: a top-level item, its children, and their children.

enable_sticky.label: Stick to the top of the screen on scroll

menu_promo.name: Menu feature card
menu_promo.paragraph: Adds an image card to the right of one menu item’s dropdown.

menu_item.label: Menu item
menu_item.info: Must match a top-level menu item exactly, for example "Shop". Capitalisation does not matter.

copyright_extra.label: Additional copyright text
copyright_extra.info: Appears after the year and your store name.

show_social.label: Show social links
show_social.info: Set the links in Theme settings → Social media.

rotate.label: Rotate through messages
rotate.info: Rotation always stops for visitors who have reduced motion turned on. The arrows keep working.

show_country.label: Show country/region selector
show_country.info: Only appears when your store sells in more than one country.

image.info: Recommended 2400 x 1350px. This is the largest image on your storefront — it decides how fast your homepage feels.

image_mobile.label: Mobile image
image_mobile.info: A portrait crop of the same scene. Falls back to the desktop image.

video.label: Video
video.info: Never loaded on phones. Visitors on mobile see the image instead, which keeps the homepage fast on cellular.

scrim_opacity.label: Image darkening
scrim_opacity.info: Darkens the image behind the text. Raise it if your photo is light and the heading is hard to read.

value.label: Value
value.info: A short figure such as 4.8 or 95%. Leave empty for a plain line of text.

heading_tag.info: Every page should have exactly one H1. Use H2 if this hero is not the main heading of the page, or if you have more than one hero.

speed.label: Speed
speed.info: Seconds for one full pass. Higher is slower.

text.label: Alt text
text.info: Describes the logo for screen readers, for example "B Corp certified".

collection.info: Leave empty to preview with demo products. Your own products appear as soon as you pick a collection.

tag.label: Material tag
tag.info: Rendered as the theme’s material tag — a small uppercase label with a hollow dot.

image.info: Overrides the collection’s own image. A lifestyle crop usually reads better here.

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.info: Sits before the number, for example a currency symbol.

faq.name: FAQ
faq.paragraph: These questions are also published as FAQ structured data, so Google can show them directly in search results.

testimonials.name: Testimonials
testimonials.paragraph: These quotes are shown to shoppers but are deliberately not published as review structured data — marking up unverified testimonials as reviews risks a Google manual action against your store.

avatar_fallback.label: Demo photo filename
avatar_fallback.info: Used only while Demo content is on and no photo is set.

hotspot.info: Pins a shoppable dot to this image. Leave empty for no hotspot.

span.label: Size
span.info: Wide and tall shots are what make the grid look editorial rather than uniform. All sizes collapse to one column on mobile.

poster.label: Poster image
poster.info: Required. Shown until the visitor presses play — the video itself is never downloaded before then.

video_url.label: External video URL
video_url.info: YouTube or Vimeo. The embed is only created once someone presses play, so no third-party frame or cookie loads on arrival.

alt.label: Description
alt.info: Describes the photo for screen readers and search engines.

link.info: Overrides the product link, for example to the original post.

level.label: Heading level
level.info: Controls the document outline for screen readers. Use H1 only if this is the main heading of the page.

image.info: Optional. Columns without an image collapse to text rather than leaving a gap.
